mapper.insert:
insert into gc_user_access_permission (user_access_id , sub_permission) values
(#{item.userAccessId}, #{item.subPermission,typeHandler=com.threeatom.common.mybatis.typehandler.FastJsonArrayTypeHandler})
ON CONFLICT (user_access_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT count(a.id) FROM ( SELECT acc.*, per.sub_permission, count(acc.id) FROM gc_user_access acc LEFT JOIN gc_user_access_permission per ON per.user_access_id = acc.id LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON per.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.id::integer) WHERE s.master_id = #{masterId} GROUP BY acc.id ) a

SELECT per.user_access_id, u.username, info.first_name, info.last_name FROM gc_user_access_permission per LEFT JOIN gc_user_access access ON access.id = per.user_access_id LEFT JOIN gc_user u ON u.id = access.user_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info info ON info.id = u.info_id WHERE access.master_id = #{masterId} AND per.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(#{subId}::integer)

SELECT
FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.master_id = #{masterId}

SELECT a.* FROM gc_user_access_permission a WHERE (a.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(#{ptId}::text) OR a.must_subject_json::jsonb @> to_jsonb(#{ptId}::integer) OR a.may_subject_json::jsonb @> to_jsonb(#{ptId}::integer))

SELECT
FROM gc_user_access_permission a left join gc_user_access ua on ua.id = a.user_access_id where ua.user_id = #{userId} and ua.master_id = #{masterId} and ua.role_json::text like concat('%',#{roleName},'%')
